Question 8
?

Find the y-intercepts of the circle (x−3)2+(y−1)2=16, shown above.

a
(0,1−7) and (0,1+7)
b
(0,2−7) and (0,2+7)
c
(0,1−5) and (0,1+5)
d
(0,−2.5) and (0,4.5)
e
(0,−2) and (0,4)
